reviewType: Independent prospective planning review; not source acquisition, extraction, scientific acceptance or release

All 63 distinct inventory source IDs resolve to canonical source records with exact title and URL equality. All source/page associations are existing page sourceIds; no duplicate exact URLs.
Plan, schema, inventory, group files and baseline are readable in the shared checkout. Same-environment operation does not require an invented external Grok transfer.

defects.issue: Inventory includes COND-C09-PAXD-PROTOCOL, a canonical Trial protocol at PMC9046747. The plan limits recovery to official regulatory/general context and says no scholarly citation is newly acquired. CONTEXT classification does not make a scholarly protocol an official label or waive its paper/review obligations.
defects.requiredCorrection: Exclude this entry from this recovery batch, or explicitly version the plan to include existing scholarly protocol recovery with its source/access/Q01-Q15 dependencies and separate protocol classification. Do not acquire it under the unreconciled v2 scope.

defects.issue: The required receipt contract is not enforced: no resolvedUrl, mediaType, observed source version/date, identityMatch/product/formulation/route/indication/jurisdiction fields, rights/redistribution state, observation ID or plan/schema version binding. full_text currently permits file=null, sha256=null, observations=[] and gaps=[]; sha256 accepts arbitrary strings. Empty sourceId/claim/locator/scope also validate by shape.
defects.requiredCorrection: Add required receipt/identity/version and observation identity fields or a separately declared receipt schema with an explicit foreign key. Require real private file/hash/media evidence for successful access, validate hashes and nonempty locators/claims, and require explained missingness/next action for failed or partial source/field coverage. Keep actual original and resolved URLs distinct. Bind source membership and page/section targets by a declared cross-record validator. Retain the six distinct existing missingness states.

defects.issue: The raw path is outside the inner application Git repository but inside the enclosing Drug Repurposing Git repository and is not currently ignored. The promise that raw sources stay outside Git is therefore not established.
defects.requiredCorrection: Choose a persistent private location outside both Git worktrees, or explicitly exclude the complete raw/staging tree in the enclosing repository and verify git check-ignore before receipt. Do not place raw sources in the batch return directory or public assets.

defects.issue: The portable minimum contract requires at least one illustrative valid record; none is supplied. The plan says returns will be validated but supplies no named validator/command or adversarial receipt cases to prove the schema and relationship rules are usable before dispatch.
defects.requiredCorrection: Supply a clearly synthetic, production-excluded successful-receipt example and missing-access example, plus an executable validation path for schema and inventory/page/source/hash closure. Verify the examples and deliberate failures for null successful receipts, unknown source IDs, identity mismatch and missing locators before recording readiness.

advisories.issue: All 63 inventory entries carry the same three generic questions, including condition-care and drug-interaction questions on generic FDA/NCCIH terminology sources. Only 48 of 66 guides have an inventory association; 18 have none, including Niclosamide, Methylene blue and Melphalan.
advisories.action: Narrow each source to relevant reader questions/active section IDs and record the excluded/no-eligible-context pages as explicit pending gaps. This bounded plan may still recover only its 63 eligible contexts; it must not claim all-page compliance from that subset.

advisories.issue: Calibration sequencing exists, but the second label and concrete pass/fail evidence are deferred. Inventory includes HTML labels, a PDF label and nonlabel official pages.
advisories.action: Before calibration dispatch name exact source IDs and expected identity/scope fields. Cover format/source variation in calibration or document why a two-label check suffices before extending to PDF and nonlabel pages. Record exact calibration acceptance separately; plan review is not that acceptance.

advisories.issue: Official-source access and product identities are prospective, not verified by existing URLs.
advisories.action: At receipt retain inaccessible/identity-mismatched sources as gaps, preserve source versions and retries, and recheck whether a changed label invalidates any dependent old claim. Never equate a DailyMed update date with an approval year.

nextSafeAction: Root integrator resolves PR-01 through PR-04, versions plan/schema/inventory as needed and records a rechecked GP Plan decision with new hashes. Independent editorial work can continue. Calibration and other dependent context recovery remain unstarted until readiness is recorded.
